data.name: Ui_OpenFileTip
data.value: Shows a ZPL file from disk as if it had been printed to LabelScope

data.name: Ui_PasteZplTip
data.value: Shows the ZPL that is on the clipboard

data.name: Ui_CopyZplTip
data.value: Copies the ZPL of the selected label

data.name: Ui_ClearJobsTip
data.value: Removes every job from the list. Printer memory is kept.

data.name: Ui_FitTip
data.value: Fits the whole label in the window

data.name: Ui_SizePickerTip
data.value: The label loaded in the printer. LabelScope uses it only when the ZPL does not give a size. Choosing another size arrives in the next update.

data.name: Ui_InstallPrinterTip
data.value: Adds the Windows printer that sends labels to LabelScope

data.name: Ui_CopyOriginalTip
data.value: Copies the ZPL exactly as it was received

data.name: Ui_ClearMemoryTip
data.value: Deletes the graphics and fonts that LabelScope keeps from ~DG, ~DY and ^IS downloads, and the font letters set with ^CW

data.name: Ui_StatusNoPrinter
data.value: Listening, but the Windows printer “{0}” is not installed. Choose Printer setup to install it.

data.name: Ui_StatusNameTaken
data.value: Listening, but another Windows printer already uses the name “{0}”. Change PrinterName in the settings.

data.name: Ui_StatusPrinterUnknown
data.value: Listening on {0}. The Windows printer could not be checked.

data.name: Ui_StatusPrinterSettings
data.value: Listening on {0}. The printer settings need fixing; see the message at the bottom.

data.name: Ui_StatusNotListening
data.value: Not listening — labels cannot arrive. See the message at the bottom for what to do.

data.name: Ui_FieldsComingSoon
data.value: Field details arrive in the next update.

data.name: Ui_LogEmpty
data.value: No warnings: every command of this label was drawn.

data.name: Ui_LogNoLabel
data.value: Select a job on the left to see what happened with it.

data.name: Ui_SelectedNone
data.value: Selected: nothing. Click a ZPL line or a warning in the Log tab.

data.name: Ui_EmptyCanvas
data.value: No label yet. Print to the Windows printer “{0}”, open a ZPL file or paste ZPL.

data.name: Ui_FileTooLarge
data.value: This file is larger than 16 MB, more than a label job can be. Choose a smaller file.

data.name: Ui_FileReadFailed
data.value: The file could not be read ({0}). Check that no other program has it open, then try again.

data.name: Ui_FileEmpty
data.value: This file holds no ZPL (no ^XA found). Choose a ZPL file.

data.name: Ui_PasteEmpty
data.value: The clipboard holds no ZPL (no ^XA found). Copy the label text first, then press Paste ZPL.

data.name: Ui_PasteFailed
data.value: The clipboard could not be read because another program is using it. Try again.
